complete_window_rule: include still-water startup, release or wave ramp, at least six distinguishable response/wave periods where the mechanism permits, and a final decay/mass audit; no 0.8 s short clip is sufficient
contact_semantics: contact_event_flag is expected to remain false for the no-contact parent; RigidAlgorithm=1 is a native SPH rigid-body path and Chrono is absent

mechanisms.description: 有限三维槽内箱浮体，初始偏离静水排水平衡后无外部驱动释放，观察 heave/roll/pitch 的衰减响应。

events.decay: envelope over final three local periods
events.fluid: source region to body-side/re-entry categories from native particle state
events.peak: successive extrema of body heave and roll/pitch
events.release: t=0 after initial still-water particle state

frame.control: no translating tank; gravity is explicit

mechanisms.description: 有限三维槽内 piston regular wave 激励自由箱浮体；浮体与侧壁、挡板和 Chrono 接触均不启用。

events.arrival: first crest at x=3.4 measuring plane
events.decay: last two cycles after forcing tail
events.fluid: source side to wave/body-side/re-entry categories with censored open-top events

frame.control: piston displacement prescribed in world time; inverse tank frame only for event planes
frame.position: world/tank geometry with tank-attached event coordinates
frame.world_transform: p_world=R_tank p_tank+c_tank; R_tank=I for translating piston background
